cond(self, inIndex, obj, outIndex)

 

The function determines if obj will be iterated, depending on

  1. if the user type of obj is in types if it is not None,
  2. if obj is a directed object (i.e. a switch or a signal) and
  3. if obj is facing or trailing.
Parameters:
  • inIndex (int | none) - The index that connects to the edge entering the node containing obj.
  • obj (IRailyardComponent) - The object whose type is checked.
  • outIndex (int | none) - The index that connects to the edge leaving the node containing obj.
Returns: bool
Return true if obj is a directed object whose direction in path is consistent with facing and user type is in types.
